text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed cushions on Church Street, between Grattan Street and Joseph Street. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed cushions should be installed on Church Street.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed cushions on Church Street, between Grattan Street and Joseph Street. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of three speed cushions on Church Street, between Grattan Street and Joseph Street, generally as shown on Attachment 2, Drawing TC-452 to the report (January 31, 2025) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
